Alpha's two applied refunds (170 and 175) match the refunds table. Order 172's refund is unrecorded, so cobalt's net balance may be overstated. I'll get each customer's net balance from the tool before deciding how to pay, starting with acme.

acme's net balance is 11259, which I'll record later. Next I'll get birch's net balance. Cobalt's figure may be overstated because order 172's refund was never recorded, so I'll check that once I have the other balances.

Alpha's two applied refunds match the refunds table, and order 172's refund is absent as reported. Next I'll get cobalt's net balance. If it still counts order 172 as refunded, it would be overstated and I'd need to hold.

Acme (11259), birch (18633), and cobalt (62037) all match orders minus the recorded refunds. But order 172's refund of 7535 failed and was never recorded, so cobalt's 62037 still includes that order's full amount. Alpha intended that refund, so paying cobalt now would overpay by 7535, and payouts can't be recalled. I'll hold the batch for human review rather than pay anyone.
